system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: As the rules and APIs of the curling game environment are specific, they need to be clearly defined in the prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt template filled with Irules, IAPIs, tactic, code, trace.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the prompt provides detailed descriptions and uses of the available interfaces
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: fixed rule/API description injected, no repository or navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: It takes the decision tree description, the corresponding implemented code and the game feedback information as input.
context_compaction.note: Each LLM call is constructed fresh from fixed inputs; no compaction described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Game progress information is following: The first game end begins, there are no stones on the ice.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Write a 'make_decision(self,)' function for a python class to complete the strategy.
tool_call_format.note: The LLM's output is Python code executed as the policy; no tool-call API.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The coder module is utilized to generate the executable Python code to implement a given decision tree tactic.
tool_count.note: No tool definitions exposed to the model; output is code only.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: You only need to define the 'make_decision(self,)' function.
edit_primitive.note: The whole function/script is regenerated each iteration.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The class has the following operation methods: - `throw_to_center(self, pos_idx: int)`: throw a stone to the center area.
tool_schema_source.note: Interface descriptions are hand-authored in the prompt.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: composed of three pivotal modules: the Large Language Model (LLM) Coder, the Reinforcement Learning (RL) Debugger, and the LLM Critic
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: This loop continues iteratively, allowing the decision tree tactic to be refined progressively.
loop_primitives.note: Coder -> RL Debugger evaluation -> Critic repair, a fixed three-stage pipeline repeated.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The LLM Critic designs an improved version of the decision tree tactic.
planning_granularity.note: The decision tree tactic description is a persisted structured strategy carried across iterations.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: composed of three pivotal modules: the Large Language Model (LLM) Coder, the Reinforcement Learning (RL) Debugger, and the LLM Critic
multi_agent_topology.note: Two LLM roles (Coder, Critic) hand off in fixed sequence.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Once the decision tree code is generated, it is passed to the RL Debugger module.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the reliance on human intervention in this process rendered the method non-automated
human_in_loop.note: The method's stated purpose is to remove human intervention.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The improvement process leverages both the previous decision tree information and the feedback from the failure of previous games
short_term_state.note: State = current decision tree tactic + code + trace, not a message list.

long_term_memory.note: Only the immediately previous tree and trace are re-injected; no cross-run memory store.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The new version of the decision tree will run in our framework for a new loop to be iteratively refined

self_verification.evidence_quote: a customized deep neural model is trained using a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to compete against the decision tree code
self_verification.note: RL Debugger is the harness-run verifier (closest to test_execution); LLM Critic reviews LLM-produced code.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The iterative refinement process terminates when RL can’t find any flaw of the tree or LLM fails to improve the tree.

rollback.evidence_quote: The refined decision tree code is passed back to the RL Debugger module, where the deep neural model is retrained to compete against it.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The LLM Critic module is unable to propose any further improvements to the decision tree tactic.
termination_condition.note: Termination when RL finds no flaw or Critic cannot improve (observed as identical regenerated code).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The iterative refinement process terminates when one of the following conditions is met
cost_controls.note: No token budget, routing or caching described.

timeouts.note: No timeouts mentioned; convergence/win-rate stabilization used instead.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: a deep neural model is trained against the generated decision tree code C in the curling game environment
execution_isolation.note: Generated Python executed inside the local curling simulator; no isolation described.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: You only need to define the 'make_decision(self,)' function.
filesystem_access.note: Generated code is confined to a single method of a policy class; no file access described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: We submit our curling AI to this platform for testing our AI’s ability.

permission_model.evidence_quote: executable decision tree code can be obtained from the LLM Coder
permission_model.note: Generated code is executed without authorisation checks.

tracing.evidence_quote: detailed records of the lost games are collected. These records include essential information, such as state transitions and actions taken during gameplay.

replayability.note: Traces recorded for critique, no replay facility described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: a customized deep neural model is trained using a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to compete against the decision tree code
eval_hooks.note: The RL Debugger plus curling environment is the built-in evaluator; Jidi platform used externally.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The generated code C is evaluated in the RL Debugger module.
guardrails.note: No filters or action policies described.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we conducted experiments in a curling game
